name: What types of data sources do I need to provide to generate a high-quality Knowledge Graph?

mainEntity.name: What types of data sources do I need to provide to generate a high-quality Knowledge Graph?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need structured data (databases, spreadsheets), semi-structured data (logs, JSON), and unstructured data (emails, documents); the more diverse and clean your sources, the richer and more accurate your entity file and graph will be.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need structured (databases), semi-structured (logs, JSON), and unstructured (emails, documents) data sources; cleaner and more diverse data yields better results.
